content:
I recently found myself in need of a Computable version of PrimrecPred.exists_mem_list, i.e.

Computable.exists_mem_list : (hf : ComputablePred p) → ComputablePred fun L : List α ↦ ∃ a ∈ L, p a

I ended up proving Computable versions of all of the Primrec theorems used in the original, but I harbor no delusion that this is guaranteed to be the best approach.

Is there an easier way to do this? I know that Computable.exists_mem_list isn't in Mathlib (because I PR'd the Primrec version), so perhaps I may still need to adapt some proofs, but going all the way back to list_casesOn' felt excessive!
